blockers.whyBlockerGrade: Four grounds, all from this lineage's own precedents. (1) B-EIR7-01: a falsified verification-status sentence standing in the resolved successor was blocker-grade one generation ago -- same class, same mode, same falsifying document, one file away. (2) B-EIR5-01: a self-published measurement false of the emitted bytes is blocker-grade; measuredResult and afterThisRepair are such measurements. (3) Freeze §7.2.2 'a caveat is a measurement': this leaf sits in knownLimitations and falsely understates assurance -- the 'buys the reader's trust with the appearance of candour' mode verbatim; a reader deciding whether to trust the 25 non-corpus-pinned vectors and the F-1 paths is told nothing outside the file corroborates them, when a 275-assertion independent review reproduced every one at 0 failures. (4) v8's own thesis: 'a repair keyed on one defect class must still recompute the OTHER measurements living in the leaf it rewrites' -- and its dispatch-level corollary, which v8's basis sentence claims to have honoured: a class repair must find the class's carriers, not one spelling family of them. The reviewer who checks only the named site certifies a repair the way v6 shipped incomplete; so does the author who sweeps only the vocabulary the last blocker happened to use.
